SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY
Louza Station,
No. S. B. D.
Date Jan. 5th. 1940.
REPORT
Subject. Private chauffeur employed by Commissioner of Police dismissed.
Made by. D.S. IO MacLennan Forwarded by. [Signature] 1/6
Sir,
At 8.45 p.m. 3-1-40 a male Chinese entered the Louza
Chinese Detective Club, No.B.8, Lane 265, Yunnan Road,
and requested to speak to C.D.I. Yue Ah Lung (尤阿根),
Senior Chinese Detective, Louza. C.D.I. Yue Ah Lung
then enquired of the man as to the purpose of his visit,
he replying "I am employed as a chauffeur by Major Bourne
whose home is located at 569, Avenue Haig": He then
requested that C.D.I. Yue confidentially register his
(chauffeur) name "Kyung Ah Nyi" at various gambling dens
in Louza District and thereby enable him to collect money
from those places: He was thereupon severely warned
by C.D.I. Yue who ordered him to leave the club immediately
and threatened to report the incident to his employer.
The man obeyed and left the club.
On 4-1-40 the details were related by C.D.I. Yue to
the D.C. "A" who notified the Commissioner of Police
and subsequently the photograph of a private chauffeur
employed by the Commissioner was identified by C.D.I.Yue
as being that of the man in question, his particulars
being:- Named Kyung Ung Zai (金鸿才), age 26, native of
Shanghai, residing at No.65 Great Western Road, O.C.L.,
driving permit No.14467 for "Hillman" motor car, S.M.C.
License No.253, the property of the Commissioner of Police
Acting on instructions from the Commissioner, C.D.S.
98 and the undersigned proceeded to the latter's home,
No.569, Avenue Haig, at 2.30 p.m. 5-1-40, and there
located the said chauffeur who was brought to Louza
Station. He, when questioned, stated that he had
（左侧手写批注）：

C. P.
Thanks

上海公共租界工部局警务处
S. B. 登记处
老闸捕房，
编号 S. B. D.
日期 1940年1月5日。
报告
事由：警务处处长雇佣的私人司机被解雇。
呈报人：D.S. IO MacLennan 转呈人：[签名] 1/6
先生，
1940年1月3日晚上8点45分，一名中国男子进入位于云南路265弄B8号的“老闸华人侦探俱乐部”，要求与老闸捕房高级华探尤阿根（Yue Ah Lung）谈话。尤阿根探员随即询问该男子来访目的，该男子回答：“我是受雇于伯恩少校（Major Bourne）的司机，其寓所位于海格路569号”。随后，他请求尤阿根探员秘密将其（司机）姓名“Kyung Ah Nyi”登记在老闸区各赌窟的名册上，以便他能从这些地方收取钱款。尤阿根探员随即对其予以严厉警告，命令其立即离开俱乐部，并威胁要将此事报告给其雇主。该男子服从并离开了俱乐部。
1940年1月4日，尤阿根探员将详细情况告知“A”分区副督察长，后者通知了警务处处长。随后，尤阿根探员指认警务处处长名下的一名私人司机的照片即为涉事男子，其个人资料如下：姓名金鸿才（Kyung Ung Zai），年龄26岁，籍贯上海，居住于西区大西路65号，持有“希尔曼”（Hillman）牌汽车的驾驶执照第14467号，以及属于警务处处长的工部局执照第253号。
根据警务处处长的指示，华探长98号及本人于1940年1月5日下午2点30分前往其后者的寓所，即海格路569号，并在那里找到了上述司机，随即将其带至老闸捕房。经讯问，他陈述道：
（左侧手写批注）：
Do A
情报
C. P.
谢谢
（印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处处长办公室 1940年1月7日）

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. ............
Station,
REPORT
(2)
Date....................19
Subject.
Made by................................Forwarded by................................
visited addresses in Louza District, including the Chun
Man Hotel, Avenue Edward VII, in an effort to ascertain
whether gambling or opium smoking was being conducted,
it having been his intention to report such places to
his employer so that the necessary action might be
instituted against them. He added that about one
month ago he passed such information to the Commissioner
in regard to certain gambling dens in the Settlement.
(It might here be noted that anonymous letters were
recently received by the S.M.P. alleging that opium
smoking was taking place at the Chun Man Hotel. Conse-
quently this hotel was raided on various occasions
following receipt of these letters but no arrests or
seizures were made. The hotel supervisor Ts Yue Dong
(周裕堂) when questioned on 5-1-40 as to whether he
suspected any person of having sent these letters stated
that a possible person was a male Chinese who appeared
at the hotel on or about the 15-12-39 and, representing
himself as a chauffeur employed by the Commissioner of
Police, he requested some money for himself (chauffeur)
and four further servants employed by the Commissioner,
then suggested that the management forward gifts to
the Commissioner and his family on a later date, as an
inducement against Police interfering with the hotel.
This supervisor was shown the photograph of the
chauffeur, referred to, and identified it as being that
of the man in question. The management, however,
refused to have action taken against the chauffeur).

事由。
呈报人................................转呈人................................
曾走访老闸区的多处地址，包括爱多亚路（Avenue Edward VII）的春曼饭店（Chun Man Hotel），以查明是否存在赌博或吸食鸦片的行为，因为他打算向雇主报告此类场所，以便采取必要行动予以取缔。他补充说，大约一个月前，他曾就公共租界内的某些赌窟向警务处处长提供过此类信息。（此处需指出，警务处最近收到匿名信，指控春曼饭店内有吸食鸦片的情况。因此，在收到这些信件后，警方对该饭店进行了多次突击搜查，但未实施逮捕或查获任何物品。1940年1月5日，当被问及是否怀疑有人寄出这些信件时，饭店主管周裕堂（Ts Yue Dong）表示，可疑人员是一名中国男子，该男子于1939年12月15日前后出现在饭店，自称是警务处处长的司机，为他自己（司机）及另外四名受雇于警务处处长的仆役索要钱财，并建议管理层日后向警务处处长及其家人赠送礼物，作为不干涉饭店经营的诱饵。向该主管出示了前述司机的照片，他指认照片中人即为涉事男子。然而，管理方拒绝对该司机采取行动）。

to the Traffic Office.

该司机由达顿警探（D.I. Tatton）及本人带至警务处处长办公室，在那里他领取了应付工资，并立即被警务处处长解雇，同时受到警告，不得再次返回海格路569号。
该司机的驾驶执照现退回交通科。

可能会被起诉并送交法庭。）
